The claim lists SSE-C as a type you simply name in the PUT request, but since the April 2026 change (change item 2026-04-06) SSE-C is blocked by default on new general purpose buckets and SSE-C writes are rejected until BlockedEncryptionTypes is set to NONE; the SSE-S3 default part is still current.
quote: While SSE-C is blocked, any `PutObject`, `CopyObject`, `PostObject`, Multipart Upload, or replication request that specifies SSE-C encryption is rejected with an HTTP 403 `AccessDenied` error.

reason: Matches the 2023-06-13 DSSE-KMS launch; later encryption changes (SSE-C blocking, UpdateObjectEncryption, encryption-type enforcement) do not change how DSSE-KMS works.

After the 2025-04-10 Express One Zone price cut (PUT -55%, GET -85%), the S3 User Guide Welcome page (fetched 2026-10-09) says request costs are 80 percent lower than S3 Standard; the 50 percent figure on storage-class-intro is the older value and the guide now contradicts itself.
quote: S3 Express One Zone is the lowest latency cloud object storage class available today, with data access speeds up to 10x faster and with request costs 80 percent lower than S3 Standard.
